arguments.prompt: Create one game sprite as a crisp outlined 2D Cartoon drawing on genuine transparent alpha. Exact pixel-art reference controls silhouette, pose, orientation, visible anatomy and occlusion; diagnostic source palette is not calibrated material color. Do not turn the pose into a generic side-view icon. Preserve all connected parts and the relative lengths/angles shown; no scenery, floor, cast shadow, glow, text or surrounding effects. Keep complete artwork inside canvas with 6% transparent margin, including every fin/claw/leg and any source line. Subject: ONE caught fish hanging head-UP with ONE visible bulging eye at upper-RIGHT and a tiny upper mouth beside the short gray source fishing-line segment. The body bows diagonally toward lower-LEFT; its curved tapering tail stalk comes down-left and the broad tail fan at BOTTOM points strongly toward screen-RIGHT, like the source. The fan's lower-left lobe drops downward, its long right lobe extends sideways. Keep the small side fins in their exact visible locations and the source body roll; do not give a flat generic horizontal fish. Reference 2 is MATERIAL STYLE ONLY: green body, pale yellow-cream belly, orange/gold patterned fins and tail, crisp black lines and cel shading. Match source anatomy with one head/one tail, no extra eyes or hands. Retain only the original short gray line segment at top.
